dest:arnhem-land:header.why: Alt: scenic view of a beach in Arnhem Land: red rocks and turquoise water. 3000x2437 (1.23:1); drone-high but oblique, not a pure aerial.

dest:east-macdonnell-ranges:header.why: Trephina Gorge red cliffs and sandy creek bed under blue sky, wide, 3:2

dest:kakadu-national-park:why4.why: Alt: visitors on the viewing platform beside the river crossing. Shows the place itself (use if the reason is reworded, e.g. "Watch the tide at Cahills Crossing" / "See the East Alligator River crossing"). 1600x1200.

dest:arnhem-land:why1.why: Visitors viewing large Yolngu-style bark paintings with an Aboriginal man pointing, in a gallery. Alt only says "Arnhem Land"; the Yirrkala art centre is the usual such venue but not named; verify. 4928x3280.

dest:arnhem-land:why2.why: Rainbow Cliffs (Banambarrnga): red-ochre cliff over a curved beach and clear water, ground level, 1333x1000 (4:3). Cliff in the upper-left third.

dest:arnhem-land:why3.why: East Woody Beach/Island at sunset: tidal sand flat and the island across it, 1333x1000. Shows the island and the flats but not a clear spit to walk.
